description:
If you keep telling yourself that love never works out, your mind will begin to make that true.

Your mind learns by repetition - so if you say:
Love never lasts.
I always choose the wrong person.
It never works for me - your mind starts looking for evidence to prove it.

When you begin to say:
I am lovable.
I am worthy of love.
Love comes to me.
What I want wants me.
I am attracting beautiful love that lasts - you start giving your mind a new instruction.

Your mind is always listening to the words you repeat, and what you affirm again and again, you begin to believe.

So stop rehearsing the story that love is hard, unavailable, or not for you. Write new words and say them out loud because when you change the words you repeat, you change what you begin to expect - and when you expect better, you start to allow better. 💛

Share in the comments the new words you are choosing for love today. ✨
